meta.requirement: Explore Stormbearer Mountains (10%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: The Ridge Wreath
start.text:
''The wind up here is thin and honest. White petals cling to a ledge where the scrub breaks, Cecilia turning slowly in a jar that should not have made this climb.''

''A woman sits with her back to a rock, gloves off, wrists red from the cold. She is counting blooms the way someone counts favors already spent.''

Marta: ''without looking up'' If you have come to tell me I am too high for a florist, save your breath. I have been telling myself the same thing for an hour.

choices.label: You climbed all this for Cecilia?

Need_a_hand_with_those.text:
Marta: ''glances at you, then at the jar'' Summit Cecilia. The city stalls sell pale copies. This is the real white. Stubborn. Clean. ''a dry breath'' My sister loved them. She used to say white flowers were the only ones that looked honest in a storm.

''She caps the jar carefully.''

Marta: I am making a wreath for her. Not a funeral. She has been gone two winters. This is for the place she liked to stand when the wind came in from Windrise. I need the other flowers that belonged with her story. I cannot fetch them alone today.

What_else_do_you_need.text:
Marta: Six Cecilia. I have a few, not enough. Five Windwheel Aster from Windrise, for the color she would have insisted on. Five Small Lamp Grass from the Whispering Woods. She walked home through those trees after dusk. The lamps should catch.

''She meets your eyes properly.''

Marta: Bring them here. I will weave on this ledge. When it is finished, I want the oak at Windrise to see it before evening. If you are willing to meet me there after, I would... appreciate not placing it alone.

choices.label: Six, five, and five. I'll bring them

Six__five__and_five__I_will_bring_them.text: Marta: ''nods once'' Good. I will stay on this ledge and finish the base. Travel the way she would have. Careful with bruised petals. The ridge already did enough bruising for one day.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring Marta 6 Cecilia, 5 Windwheel Aster, and 5 Small Lamp Grass at Stormbearer Mountains

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click on Deliver Flowers to Marta

le_mart.text:
''Marta has cleared a flat patch of stone and laid out twine, wire, and a half-built ring of green stems. The jar of Cecilia sits in shade under her coat.''

Marta: ''straightens'' Back. Tell me the mountain cooperated.

choices.label: Here. 6 Cecilia, 5 Windwheel Aster, 5 Small Lamp Grass

still_gathering.text: Marta: ''returns to the wire without impatience'' Then I will keep the ring honest until you do. Cecilia keeps on the high cold. Aster turns with the meadow wind. Lamp Grass waits for dusk. If you already knew, forgive the reminder.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring Marta 6 Cecilia, 5 Windwheel Aster, and 5 Small Lamp Grass at Stormbearer Mountains

submit_flowers.text:
''Marta takes each bundle in turn. Cecilia she weighs like coin. Windwheel Aster she holds to the light for color. Small Lamp Grass she cups briefly against the shade of her sleeve, imagining night.''

Marta: ''quietly'' These will hold.

''Her hands move fast then, weaving white and gold and soft green into the ring until the ledge smells like a summer the mountain does not keep.''

Marta: Windrise. Under the great oak, west side of the trunk. I will go down the main trail. If you beat me there, wait. If I beat you, I will wait. ''almost a smile'' We finish this together.

meet_u_at_wind.text: ''She lifts the finished wreath with both hands, careful of the Cecilia at the crest, and starts downslope without looking back. The wind catches a Lamp Grass stem and sets it faintly glowing even in daylight.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Meet Marta at Windrise to place the ridge wreath

continues.label: Go to Windrise (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Place the Wreath with Marta

wreath_placed.title: Wreath Placed
wreath_placed.text:
''Marta is already at the oak, wreath braced against the west bark where the wind moves freely. She has cleared a spot of grass with her boot and is fussing a Windwheel Aster half a finger to the left.''

Marta: ''softly'' You came. Good.

''Together you set the wreath into place. For a moment the three kinds look like they have always belonged to this trunk: high white, meadow gold, dusk-soft green.''

Marta: ''brushing dirt from her gloves'' She would have laughed at me for climbing that ridge alone. Then she would have demanded better Aster. ''a real smile this time'' You found the better Aster.

''She presses a folded purse into your palm.''

Marta: For the walking. And for waiting with me. That part mattered more than the wire.
